title: Fed rate hike announcement on bank stock returns
research_question: Do unexpected Federal Reserve interest rate hike announcements generate positive cumulative abnormal returns (CAR) for bank stocks in the [-1,+1] window?
data_description: Event study data for 80 bank stocks around a single Fed rate hike event. Variables: stock_id, event_day (−10 to +10), ret (daily return), mkt_ret (S&P 500 return), beta (pre-estimated market model beta). Use days −10 to −2 as estimation window to compute expected returns; event window is [−1, +1].
